labels.exists: a real component on the PDI
labels.missing_real: it should exist according to the story, but it does not exist on the PDI (projected onto the article: non-existent)
labels.variant: a spelling variant of a real/missing_real name
labels.external: an object of an external (non-ServiceNow) system — not to be validated (out of scope)

decision_mapping.missing_real: not_exists (the job of the gate: signal it)
decision_mapping.variant_of_existing: exists (a reference) — if the variant_of is exists
decision_mapping.external: no decision — the calibrated layer says 'not a SNOW component' (the gate does not signal it)
